verdict.rationale: The docs say ADK can run offline or disconnected in a system with no connection to Google Cloud. Agents can be packaged as containers and run in any environment that supports them, including via `adk deploy docker` locally. Adapters for other providers and locally running models remove model-vendor lock-in. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of fully disconnected operation, and documentation of self-hosted replacements for session, memory and artifact storage (examples default to Gemini and google_search).
